_comment: Per-tile collision overrides, keyed by tileset number then tile index.
Collision is a property of the TILE, not the cell (RPG-Maker model).
Evidence: every 'cur' cell in ff4_cell.txt is a cell the actor was
standing on, so pass=NO there is definitively a bug; and two sets of
tiles with IDENTICAL byte1/byte2 behave differently in the real game,
which is why the two prop bytes cannot express the rule alone.

5._passable_note: 122: byte1=0x00 but the actor stood on it (map-edge trigger tile)
_evidence: Mist report (green, should be red): 17  (byte1=0x02 byte2=0x0C, same shape as 75/76 = roofs)
Baron report 2 (red, should be green): relied on the default rule, only 122 needed an override

6._dirs_note: Bit masks of allowed movement directions across this tile's edges. Bits: 1=up 2=right 4=down 8=left. 'lr'=0x0A. Applied to BOTH entering and leaving, so a bed blocks up/down in both directions.
